text:
sophia (people-ops): Heads up — new hire Michael Chen starts Mon 2026-04-13, remote (NY). Laptop shipped. Need to confirm I-9 flow, background-check status, and the day‑1 orientation agenda. Passport on file expires July — can that block I-9?

taylor (hr): Congrats! For remote hires we support two I-9 paths: 1) in-person verification at a local authorized verifier within 3 business days of start, or 2) in-office verification if they can come by any Redwood office. Important: documents must be unexpired at time of verification. If passport is expiring in July and his start is April, it's fine. If it were already expired we'd need alternate docs (DL + SS card). I'll DM Michael the options and include verifier list. :white_check_mark:

jamie (onboarding-ops): Quick checklist I'm tracking:
- Background check: Checkr invite resent (I saw the email bounce once) — action: michael needs to complete consent + ID upload.
- Payroll forms: W-4 + direct deposit in Rippling (invite sent).
- Benefits: new hire enrollment window opens on day 1 for 30 days.
- Day‑1 agenda: 10:00 intro + compliance, 11:00 benefits overview, 12:00 lunch, 1:00 access/setup with IT, 3:00 manager sync.
Link: https://onboarding.redwood.com/portal/michael-chen (internal)

mike-it: Laptop delivery scheduled for Fri EOD. IT will do remote provisioning and Zoom handoff at 09:30 on Monday. Please confirm shipping address in Rippling matches the one used for delivery. I'll set up Okta/Slack/GitHub invites once provisioning completes.

sophia (people-ops): Thanks — Jamie, can you paste the acceptable I-9 docs here so I can DM Michael quickly?

jamie (onboarding-ops): Sure — short list we use in practice (copy for quick DM):
```
Acceptable I-9 docs (summary):
- List A (one document): U.S. passport, Permanent Resident Card (Form I-551)
- OR List B + List C: State driver's license + Social Security card OR birth certificate
Note: documents MUST be original for verification (no photocopies).
```

onboarding-bot: background-check status: INVITE_SENT -> PENDING_CONSENT (Checkr).

jamie (onboarding-ops): I've created the "Remote Day‑1 Orientation" calendar invite with Zoom link and attached the benefits packet + compliance checklist. I've also set a 9:15am pre-check with IT for provisioning. If Michael can't complete the Checkr consent before Monday, we can still onboard but will block code access until clear.

mike-it: One more thing — if Michael's passport were expired we'd accept DL + SS card for I-9 remote verification. If he chooses an authorized agent, ask them to email me a photo of the verifier badge (company policy).

sophia (people-ops): Great, sounds covered. I'll follow up with Michael about Checkr + Rippling address and confirm his preference for verifier vs. in-office. Leaving this thread open for any last-minute issues. :slightly_smiling_face:
